scope: 48 existing curriculum topic guides, selected from the 676 guides in the current manifest. Owner expectation of 687 remains unreconciled.
selection_method: Prioritise prior Search Console visibility, focused parent/teacher topic intent, coherent primary-school clusters, existing useful static teaching and actual resource availability. External search results validate vocabulary/resource intent only; no keyword-volume data or claim of the 48 highest-volume codes.
sources: Google Search Console native comparison: 2026-09-01–28 versus 2026-09-29–10-26; AC9M3M04 450→10, AC9M3M03 355→2, AC9M4N02 118→4, AC9M1SP01 118→6
Search intent observations on 2026-10-28: year 3 time/fractions/multiplication, year 5–6 fractions/decimals/percentages; existing educational resource results, not volume estimates.
